source_path.description: Path to the source device or file to rescue data from.

dest_path.description: Path to the destination file or device for the rescued data.

block_size.description: Blocksize for default read operations in bytes. Corresponds to -b.

skip_block_size.description: Blocksize in bytes when skipping over badblocks. Accepts integer, percentage, or multiplier. Corresponds to -f.

resolution.description: Resolution in bytes when searching for bad area edges. Accepts integer, percentage, or multiplier. Corresponds to -r.

retry_count.description: Minimum read attempts on the first bad block. Corresponds to -R.

seek_on_error.description: Number of times to force seek read head from start to end on error. Corresponds to -Z.

low_level_mode.description: Low level device call mode: 0=No, 1=Error recovery only, 2=Always. Corresponds to -L.

synchronized_read.description: If true, use synchronized read calls (O_SYNC/O_DIRECT). Corresponds to --sync.

force_reopen.description: If true, keep trying to reopen source after read error. Corresponds to --forceopen.

start_block.description: Start position in blocks to read from. Corresponds to -s.

max_length_blocks.description: Maximum length in blocks to read. Empty or 0 means entire input. Corresponds to -l.

incremental_badblock_file.description: Path to a file containing badblock entries for incremental mode (-I). Empty string disables incremental mode.

incremental_badblock_block_size.description: Blocksize to interpret the incremental badblock file. Empty string implies BLOCK_SIZE. Corresponds to -i.

continue_at_block.description: Block position to continue copying at. Empty string implies no specific continue position (0 if incremental). Corresponds to -c.

exclude_badblock_file.description: Path to a file containing badblock entries for exclusion mode (-X). Empty string disables exclusion.

exclude_badblock_block_size.description: Blocksize to interpret the exclude badblock file. Empty string implies BLOCK_SIZE. Corresponds to -x.

badblock_output_file.description: Path to write a badblocks/e2fsck compatible bad block file. Empty string disables output.

seek_script.description: Path to an external script for seeking in input files (e.g., tapes). Empty string disables external seek.

mark_string.description: String to mark unrecovered data. Empty string disables marking (zero-pad/skip). Corresponds to -M.

debug_level.description: Debug output level bit field. Corresponds to --debug.

timing_file.description: Path to write sector read timing information. Empty string disables timing file.
